notes: New error window: when an important error happens (installing AniVocal, Upscale or FFmpeg, or a failed update), a clear "Something went wrong" window appears with an X, a plain-words explanation and a Send report button.
Send report opens the bug report already filled in for that kind of error, with the details attached. You can edit everything before sending, and nothing is sent without your click.
New clipboard icon next to install errors to copy the log in one click.
AniVocal install fixed: it now shows the MB installed and the current step, finishes on its own, and Check no longer says "installed" while the install is still running.
SHA256 and ZIP checks, size limits, one update at a time, automatic backup and rollback.
